author: blu
body: Proves Black Lotus: the iconic sacrifice-for-mana source. Its Oracle text "{T}, Sacrifice Black Lotus: Add three mana of any one color." compiles to a FlexManaAbility whose cost is a sacrifice and whose amount is 3. It is NOT tapped by the greedy mana routine (cracking destroys it); instead the caster cracks it only to bridge a spell it can afford this turn. Here player 0 has no lands but holds a 3-cost green creature; the AI sacrifices the Lotus for three green and powers the creature out turn one -- and the Lotus is gone.
